name: agemon
description: agemon's skill groups for Claude: pick the groups you want, in claude.ai or Claude Code.

plugins.name: agemon-essentials
plugins.description: Web design and writing guidelines from Vercel Labs.

plugins.name: agemon-design
plugins.description: agemon-design: a staged UI workflow that reads your real brand, builds from the subject, and reports what it could not verify. Auto-triggering is not guaranteed, its gates are voluntary, and a passing run does not mean a good design.

plugins.name: agemon-security
plugins.description: Exploit-driven security review — no finding without a working proof-of-concept, CVSS-aligned severity — plus a multi-agent, multi-phase codebase audit with independently verified findings.

plugins.name: agemon-code-quality
plugins.description: Simplicity, DRY architecture, self-documenting naming, and surgical scope control for day-to-day edits.

plugins.name: agemon-architecture
plugins.description: Clean Architecture review: dependency rule, layer separation, boundary crossing, SOLID.

plugins.name: agemon-self-review
plugins.description: Verification before claiming completion, giving and receiving code review, and root-cause-first debugging.

plugins.name: agemon-performance
plugins.description: Algorithmic-complexity-first discipline: N+1 detection, hot-loop hygiene, and when not to optimize.

plugins.name: agemon-commit
plugins.description: Staging review, commit message structure, and splitting unrelated changes into separate commits.

plugins.name: agemon-nuxt-vue
plugins.description: Vue 3, Nuxt, Nitro, Pinia, Vite, Vitest and UnoCSS reference skills generated from each project's docs at a pinned commit. They describe the versions current at that commit (Nuxt 5); check your project's versions.

plugins.name: agemon-browser-testing
plugins.description: Test a local web app in a real browser by writing Python Playwright scripts: start the dev server, inspect the rendered page, capture screenshots and console logs. Needs Python 3 and Playwright with its browsers, which agemon does not install. The agent runs Python and your server commands, so expect permission prompts.

plugins.name: agemon-motion
plugins.description: Motion design for UI animation: timing, easing, choreography and Disney principles adapted for interfaces, for CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lottie or any animation system.

plugins.name: agemon-teamlead
plugins.description: Team-lead workflows: RFC planning, PRD generation/decomposition, meeting lifecycle, task extraction, tech spikes, IT audits, incident RCA, security checks, tech-lead review, and Obsidian vault sync.

plugins.name: agemon-geo-seo
plugins.description: Audit and optimize websites for AI search citation (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews): citability, AI crawlers, llms.txt, schema, technical SEO, reports.

plugins.name: agemon-workflow
plugins.description: Structured feature delivery: brainstorming, written plans, test-driven development, subagent or inline execution, git worktrees, and branch finishing. Pairs with Self-Review.

plugins.name: agemon-output-style
plugins.description: agemon-adhd: on request, replies lead with the next action, number their steps, restate progress, and skip preamble and tangents.

plugins.name: agemon-founder
plugins.description: Test a business idea before launch: board review, competitors, simulated buyer panel, pricing, offer, unit economics, marketing, brand, operations, launch, and a business plan with a computed verdict.
